bestBets.overview: Racing at Doomben in Brisbane on Saturday, 9 races set down, smallish fields early in the day. Track rated a soft (5) at scratching time this morning, with the chance of a shower, should they stay away expect an upgrade. The meeting gets underway with a Class 3 for the girls where on paper there is no clear leader, 2 & 4 have raced handily however that's all I can tell you. TRAFALGAR SQUARE brings a different form line than the majority, likely a stronger one, she's the tip. 1, 2 & 3 all chances.

raceTips.comment: PEREILLE continues to race well without winning. With four weeks since his latest run, where he charged home to claim second in the Ramornie, he comes here on the fresh side. He’s been placed in all three starts at Doomben and with a clear run home, he’ll be strong late. HELL comes off a solid first up effort to finish third at Eagle Farm and strips for it. He performs well here at Doomben and Emily Lang knows him well. NETTUNO endured a torrid run when resuming over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast last month. Freshened, the step to 1200m suits and if he can find cover early, he’ll be powering home late. CASPERNOVA is racing well but struggled up see out 1400m last start. The drop back in trip suits and he gets in beautifully with just 52.5kgs.
